text.tspan: Disaggregation: prefill and decode on separate, independently scaled workers
A big prompt's prefill pauses everyone's decode → answers stutter
Can't give the two jobs different GPUs or scale them separately
Each pool gets its own GPU count and tuning → steadier speed and better GPU use.
The cost: the KV cache must move between machines, so this needs a fast network and more moving parts.
